queries: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_average_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL), above_average AS (SELECT p.ID, p.average_hgb, o.overall_average_hgb FROM patient_averages p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.average_hgb > o.overall_average_hgb), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_hgb) AS mean_patient_average_hgb FROM above_average) SELECT a.ID AS patient_id, a.average_hgb, a.average_hgb - a.overall_average_hgb AS above_overall_average, a.average_hgb - m.mean_patient_average_hgb AS above_average_patient_difference FROM above_average a CROSS JOIN above_average_mean m ORDER BY above_average_patient_difference DESC, patient_id LIMIT 10
